item.title: Bank of England set to hold rates as inflation rise cools cut expectations
item.description: The Bank of England is expected to keep interest rates on hold at 3.75% this week after inflation ticked up, though governor Andrew Bailey may signal a spring cut. Read more: Bank of England set to hold rates as inflation rise cools cut expectations

item.title: British factories cut US exports as Trump tariff uncertainty bites
item.description: UK manufacturers are pulling back from the US market as Donald Trump’s tariff threats disrupt trade, with more than a third reporting a negative impact, according to Make UK and DHL. Read more: British factories cut US exports as Trump tariff uncertainty bites

item.title: HMRC plans £2bn technology spending spree as legacy systems prove stubborn
item.description: HMRC is preparing to spend more than £2bn on new technology contracts, including major cloud and data deals, as efforts to retire legacy systems run over budget and behind schedule. Read more: HMRC plans £2bn technology spending spree as legacy systems prove stubborn

item.title: One in five SMEs cut staff as tax and cost pressures intensify, survey finds
item.description: Rising taxes and operating costs forced 21% of UK SMEs to cut staff last year, according to new research from Rathbones, with hospitality firms hardest hit. Read more: One in five SMEs cut staff as tax and cost pressures intensify, survey finds

item.title: Calls grow for UK to freeze hotel business rate revaluations as costs soar
item.description: Hotel operators and tax experts are urging the UK Government to follow Northern Ireland’s lead and freeze hotel business rate revaluations, warning of six-figure annual increases from 2026. Read more: Calls grow for UK to freeze hotel business rate revaluations as costs soar

item.title: Betfred brothers top Sunday Times tax list with £400m bill as stars and entrepreneurs pay record sums
item.description: The Betfred brothers top the Sunday Times 2026 Tax List after paying £400m, with Harry Styles the highest-contributing celebrity and Erling Haaland the youngest entry. Read more: Betfred brothers top Sunday Times tax list with £400m bill as stars and entrepreneurs pay record sums

item.title: High streets to receive £150m boost – but business leaders warn it is “a sticking plaster on a gaping wound”
item.description: The government has announced a £150m High Streets Strategy to revive struggling town centres, but small business owners warn the funding falls far short of what is needed to reverse years of decline. Read more: High streets to receive £150m boost – but business leaders warn it is “a sticking plaster on a gaping wound”

item.title: House of Lords AI summit urges agentic AI to ‘rejuvenate’ UK economy
item.description: A House of Lords AI summit has called for wider adoption of agentic AI to boost UK productivity, support SMEs and address a looming skills gap across the economy. Read more: House of Lords AI summit urges agentic AI to ‘rejuvenate’ UK economy

item.title: SpaceX acquires xAI as Elon Musk moves to unite rockets, satellites and artificial intelligence
item.description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has acquired xAI in a landmark deal that brings rockets, Starlink satellites, X and the Grok chatbot under one roof ahead of a potential blockbuster IPO later this year. Read more: SpaceX acquires xAI as Elon Musk moves to unite rockets, satellites and artificial intelligence

item.title: FTSE 100 hits record high as dollar rallies and gold extends sharp pullback
item.description: The FTSE 100 closed at a record high as a stronger dollar lifted UK equities, while gold, silver and oil prices fell sharply amid volatile global markets. Read more: FTSE 100 hits record high as dollar rallies and gold extends sharp pullback
